name: Footwear
description: Footwear brands (work, outdoor, and lifestyle) evaluated on search relevance. Platforms vary — Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware), or custom. Search is read from the shopper-facing engine for a bounded query set: no crawling, no scraping, no server load. Query packs test product-type + attribute (waterproof, steel toe, leather), synonyms (sneakers/trainers), gender/size intent, and job/use-case intent (work boots for concrete, hiking).
